caption: The drawing depicts a single large, curved object resembling a whale tooth or scrimshaw in the center of an otherwise empty background. The tooth is colored in shades of beige and light brown with shading to give it a three-dimensional appearance. Engraved on the surface of the tooth, there is an illustration of a three-masted sailing ship with detailed rigging and sails. The ship is set on a stylized depiction of the ocean, rendered with thin, wavy lines to represent water. To the right of the tooth, the name “carl strehlau” is written in small, neat red letters. In the bottom right corner of the drawing, there are handwritten notations: "Fig 319" and "Page 140." The background is plain and light-colored, with no other objects or embellishments present.
title: Horn
